For purposes of this subsection, “resident of Iowa” means 6 any of the following: 7 (1) An individual who graduated from an Iowa high school. 8 (2) An individual who has lived in Iowa for at least four 9 consecutive years immediately preceding the date the individual 10 begins classes at the college of law at the state university 11 of Iowa. 12 EXPLANATION 13 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 14 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 15 This bill relates to the university of Iowa college of law, 16 including priority for admission and reporting requirements. 17 The bill requires the state board of regents to adopt a 18 policy providing that not less than 80 percent of students 19 accepted into the college of law be residents of Iowa or 20 persons who were, prior to applying to the college of law, 21 enrolled in an eligible postsecondary institution as defined in 22 Code section 261E.2. The bill further requires that the board 23 of regents adopt a policy giving priority for admission to 24 residents of Iowa who apply to the college of law, and a policy 25 requiring an application for admission to the college of law to 26 include an applicant attestation. 27 The bill requires the university of Iowa submit an annual 28 report to the general assembly containing, for the immediately 29 preceding calendar year, the number of applicants who are 30 residents of Iowa who were accepted to the college of law and 31 the number of applicants who are residents of Iowa who were 32 not accepted, including a brief statement related to why each 33 applicant was denied. 34 The bill defines “resident of Iowa” as an individual who 35 -2- LSB 5083YC (4) 91 mb/jh 2/ 3 H.F. _____ graduated from an Iowa high school or an individual who has 1 lived in Iowa for at least four consecutive years immediately 2 preceding the date of beginning classes at the college. 3 -3- LSB 5083YC (4) 91 mb/jh 3/ 3
